message.content: This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover for "TEMPO," with large red lettering across the top. The image depicts a cluttered urban scene dominated by a tall wooden utility pole on the left, which is overwhelmed by a dense, chaotic tangle of black electrical wires. Two men in blue work vests and white hardhats are present. One man stands on a tall wooden ladder leaning against the pole, reaching into the wire nest. The second man stands on the ground, wiping sweat from his forehead with a cloth. A white van with red and blue stripes is parked on the right. In the background, simple brown building structures are visible. Several orange traffic cones are scattered around the base of the pole. A small birdcage hangs among the wires. The main text reads "AWAS SETRUM!" in large, white, blocky letters. Smaller text includes "MENTERI BUMN ERICK THOHIR INGIN PLN TAK LAGI MENGURUS BISNIS PEMBANGKIT LISTRIK. MEWARNAI TARIK ULUR PENENTUAN DIREKTUR UTAMA BARU." Other text includes "KEPALA RESERSE UTUSAN JOKOWI" and "FILM PILIHAN TEMPO 2019" at the top.
